definitions.explanation: The quality of being humble and yielding to others, particularly by lowering oneself. Central to the Japanese politeness system, especially in the context of humble language (謙譲語).

examples.japanese: {謙譲|けんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美徳|びとく}→美徳：13899_bitoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧。
examples.english: To value the virtue of humility.

examples.japanese: {謙譲|けんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ようにしたい。
examples.english: I want to always keep a spirit of humility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧とき、⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{尊敬語|そんけいご}→尊敬語：17106_sonkeigo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一種|いっしゅ}→一種：01628_isshu⟧だ。
examples.english: When studying Japanese, humble language is an important type of keigo alongside honorific language.

notes:
USAGE:
{謙譲|けんじょう} is most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧ (humble language), one of the three main categories of Japanese keigo (⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧). On its own, it describes the attitude of humble self-restraint.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧ (humble language — lowers the speaker to show respect)
- {謙譲|けんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美徳|びとく}→美徳：13899_bitoku⟧ (the virtue of humility)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {謙譲|けんじょう}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (a humble attitude)
- {謙譲|けんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧ (a spirit of humility)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{謙虚|けんきょ}→謙虚：00215_kenkyo⟧ (humble, modest) is a more common everyday word for humility as a personal quality. {謙譲|けんじょう} has a more formal, traditional tone and is strongly associated with the keigo system.
